title: ExistingTicketsToGithub
description: process-issues: one page of a project's unarchived items with each item's title and body. The first page sends a null cursor; later pages send the previous page's endCursor. A POST /graphql whose JSON body is this, exactly as sent: the operation text byte for byte, plus its variables (values are never written into the operation text). The token goes in the Authorization header with Accept: application/vnd.github+json and X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28.
